claim_boundary: Already studied June development evidence; no independent test, execution, profitability, deployment, or promotion claim.

benchmark_definitions.empirical_marginal_train_only: Registered train-only q10/q50/q90 for each horizon-target cell.
benchmark_definitions.zero_degenerate: All normalized quantiles fixed at zero; a degenerate no-distribution location check.
benchmark_definitions.utc_hour_train_only: Train-only empirical cell quantiles conditioned on decision UTC hour.
benchmark_definitions.trailing_three_complete_days: For each forward UTC day, empirical quantiles from the three prior fully matured days.
benchmark_definitions.causal_residual_persistence: Prior fully matured one-minute target plus train-fitted residual quantiles.
benchmark_definitions.status: Only the empirical marginal was registered; all other context baselines are post hoc.

overlap_sensitivity.definition: one sample every 64 minutes for each of 64 clock phases

example_trace.status: single execution trace; not representative performance

same_corpus_full_model_context.warning: same accessed partition; not an architectural superiority test

historical_full_model_economic_context_n.warning: historical full-model diagnostic only; not a Tiny backtest

method_notes: All added baselines and diagnostics are post hoc on an already accessed development partition.
The trailing-three-day and persistence baselines use only labels fully matured before each forecast origin.
Aggregate physical interval width is intentionally omitted because target units differ.
Three marginal quantiles do not define a joint predictive distribution or executable strategy.
Daily and 64-phase summaries are descriptive; four days do not support reliable inference.
